Its callees include classify_record_status_against_context_statuses_1_2 and apply_uniform_context_value_to_three_slots. No indexed callers available; record/context wording is provisional.

No indexed callers available; threshold/condition captures the observed calculation without assigning attribute meanings.

Inspected body: requires context status 3, iterates entries using 0x48-byte steps, calls two helpers to retrieve values, tracks a maximum-like quantity, and returns a boolean or -2 (decompiled/main/main_0094.c:8217-8268, 8273-8306). The element and return-condition semantics are unclear, so no rename is proposed.

The routine reads and updates the 32-bit state at object offset 0x378c, derives a slot index from the context status, and on a state change normalizes per-slot control data before calling f_7000cedf14 and initialize_season_record_detail_blocks (decompiled/main/main_0088.c:39902-39928, 39934-39942, 39944-39976). The latter callee is already identified as initializing season-record detail blocks. No callers are indexed; “state” is intentionally generic.

This adjacent variant also updates the 32-bit state at object offset 0x378c and, on change, prepares per-slot control data then calls f_7000cedf14 and initialize_season_record_detail_blocks (decompiled/main/main_0088.c:40003-40029, 40035-40043, 40045-40077).
